title: Cannot download data from night scout after reinstallation
body: Need to reinstall xdrip after recent Samsung S9 Android 10 update that messed up the Bluetooth connections.  Got all to work but cannot get xdrip to download past BG and treatment data from night scout even though I have enabled Download Data under Cloud Upload > Nightscout Sync... Still cannot get it to work.  History on xdrip only had BG from a day and I am hoping to restore three months of past BG data
